title: Split the MS-STD configuration package into functional-area packages
summary: The MS-STD configuration package is split into nine functional-area packages (Finance, Inventory, Inventory Valuation, Manufacturing, Projects, Purchase, Sales, Subscription Billing, and Sustainability). New installations register these packages as inactive, while upgrades activate the new packages and remove the legacy MS-STD package.
key_points: MS-STD configuration package split into nine functional-area packages
New installations register packages as inactive
Existing installations migrate by activating new packages and removing MS-STD
Install and upgrade logic reorganized for clarity
Tables from old package not in new definitions may no longer be selectable through that package
